We need efficiency = (useful energy to melt the aluminum) / (energy supplied by welding machine) *100%.

Energy supplied = power * time = 1.7 kW * 20 s = 1.7*1000*20 = 34,000 J.

Energy required to heat from 25 to 660°C: ΔT = 660-25 = 635 K. Q1 = m*c*ΔT = 0.02 kg * 880 J/kg·K * 635 K = 0.02*880*635.

Total required Q = 11,176 + 8,000 = 19,176 J.

Efficiency = 19,176 / 34,000 = 0.5634 = 56.34%.
